def _parse_number(s, pos, n):
    start = pos
    is_float = False
    
    # Sign
    if pos < n and s[pos] == '-':
        pos += 1
    
    # Integer part
    if pos >= n:
        raise JSONError("invalid number", pos)
    c = s[pos]
    if c == '0':
        pos += 1
        # Next char must not be a digit
        if pos < n and s[pos] >= '0' and s[pos] <= '9':
            raise JSONError("invalid number (leading zero)", pos)
    elif c >= '1' and c <= '9':
        pos += 1
        while pos < n and s[pos] >= '0' and s[pos] <= '9':
            pos += 1
    else:
        raise JSONError("invalid number", pos)
    
    # Fraction part
    if pos < n and s[pos] == '.':
        is_float = True
        pos += 1
        if pos >= n or s[pos] < '0' or s[pos] > '9':
            raise JSONError("invalid number (no digits after .)", pos)
        while pos < n and s[pos] >= '0' and s[pos] <= '9':
            pos += 1
    
    # Exponent part
    if pos < n and s[pos] in 'eE':
        is_float = True
        pos += 1
        if pos < n and s[pos] in '+-':
            pos += 1
        if pos >= n or s[pos] < '0' or s[pos] > '9':
            raise JSONError("invalid number (no digits in exponent)", pos)
        while pos < n and s[pos] >= '0' and s[pos] <= '9':
            pos += 1
    
    text = s[start:pos]
    if is_float:
        return float(text), pos
    else:
        return int(text), pos
